metadata.question: Does the forest fire burn over 0.8 million hectares of land in Quebec, Canada in 2023?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest fire burn area in Quebec, Canada in 2023. I need to: 1. Use burned area data - MODIS Burned Area product (MCD64A1) would be appropriate 2. Define Quebec geometry (can use a rough bounding box) 3. Filter for 2023 data 4. Calculate total burned area in hectares 5. Check if it exceeds 0.8 million hectares (800,000 ha) For data quality: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Validate the result is reasonable (C3) - Compare against threshold for A/B answer I'll use MCD64A1.006 which has burned area data at 500m resolution. The 'BurnDate' band has day of burn, and I can count burned pixels to calculate area. Each pixel is 500x500m = 25 hectares. Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const quebec = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-79.8, 45.0, -57.1, 63.0]); // Quebec bounding box const startDate = '2023-01-01'; const endDate = '2023-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area product const burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(quebec); const collectionSize = burnedArea.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Burned Area Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create binary burned mask (BurnDate > 0 means burned) const burnedMask = burnedArea.select('BurnDate').max().gt(0); // 3. Processing - Calculate burned area in hectares // Each pixel is 500x500m = 25 hectares const pixelAreaHa = 25; // hectares per pixel // Count burned pixels const burnedStats = burnedMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const burnedPixels = burnedStats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); console.log(`Burned Pixels: ${burnedPixels}`); if (burnedPixels === null || burnedPixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate total burned area in hectares const totalBurnedHa = burnedPixels * pixelAreaHa; console.log(`Total Burned Area: ${totalBurnedHa.toLocaleString()} hectares`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (totalBurnedHa === null || totalBurnedHa === undefined || isNaN(totalBurnedHa) || totalBurnedHa < 0) { console.log("C3"); } else if (totalBurnedHa > 800000) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
